gloss: military service; serving in the army; following the troops

definitions.gloss: military service; accompanying the army; serving at the front
definitions.explanation: Serving in or accompanying a military force, especially in wartime. Used for both soldiers and non-combatants (journalists, nurses) who accompany troops.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{従軍|じゅうぐん}{経験|けいけん}がある。
examples.english: My grandfather has experience serving in the military.

examples.japanese: {従軍|じゅうぐん}{記者|きしゃ}が{前線|ぜんせん}から{報告|ほうこく}した。
examples.english: An embedded journalist reported from the front line.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{若|わか}くして{従軍|じゅうぐん}し、{戦地|せんち}で{多|おお}くのことを{学|まな}んだ。
examples.english: He served in the military at a young age and learned much in the war zone.

notes:
Composed of {従|じゅう} (to follow, to accompany) + {軍|ぐん} (army, military). Originally meant "to follow the army" and can refer to both combatants and non-combatants who accompany military forces.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {従軍|じゅうぐん}{記者|きしゃ}: war correspondent; embedded journalist
- {従軍|じゅうぐん}{看護婦|かんごふ}: military nurse (historical)
- {従軍|じゅうぐん}{経験|けいけん}: military service experience
- {従軍|じゅうぐん}する: to serve in the military; to follow the troops

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {兵役|へいえき}: military service, conscription — focuses on compulsory service
- {出征|しゅっせい}: going to war — emphasizes departing for the battlefield
- {入隊|にゅうたい}: enlisting — the act of joining the military
